title: No-Fry Easy Zucchini Parmesan
description: This recipe for no-fry Zucchini Parmesan includes grated zucchini, dried oregano, garlic, and a cheesy topping with Mexican cheese blend and Parmesan.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 cup shredded Mexican cheese blend (such as Great Value Fiesta Blend®), or more to taste

steps.text: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven’s broiler. Grease an 8-inch baking pan.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add zucchini, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Increase heat to medium; cook and stir until zucchini is almost soft, about 7 minutes. Drain excess liquid.
Transfer zucchini mixture to the prepared baking pan; sprinkle Mexican cheese blend and Parmesan over zucchini.
Broil in the preheated oven until cheeses are melted and start to turn brown, about 7 minutes.
